_comment: SCCL v5b: CAPABILITY PROBES (Branch C of RESEARCH_NOTES_v5.md). Motivation: the v5 corrected factorial showed accepted updates whose stored instance-level self-tests still pass while the underlying CAPABILITY degrades (instance-vs-capability gap; e.g. sccl_strat@44 arith). v5b manufactures one capability probe per certification (numeric/paraphrase variant with fresh self-tests via SelfCertifier.make_probe), stores them in the vault (kind=cap_probe, newest-per-family bounded pool), and adds a gold-free RRV stratum that re-checks them before every accepted update. Bounded-damage guard: if >= 50% of a family phase's vetoes are cap-vetoes, the guard arms cap_margin=2 extra regeneration retries before vetoing, so a single noisy probe cannot stall learning. All switches default OFF; frozen and sccl rows must bit-reproduce runs/sccl_v5_fixed (seeds 42/43 unchanged) as the inertness + determinism check. Same stream hash 554ce43f182b, torch_seed=42, seed=42+learner index. Gold-free throughout (gold only final eval/telemetry). Pre-registered success: sccl_capprobe_strat arith >= 0.55 AND frontier >= sccl.frontier - 0.02 -> multi-seed before any headline claim. Pre-registered prediction: if capability loss dominates, vetoes fire inside family phases and arith stabilizes near frozen 0.6 with a measurable plasticity cost.
